weight-converter.quickAnswer: Enter the weight, pick the unit you have and the one you want. Conversion uses exact definitions — 1 lb = 453.59237 g and 1 oz = 28.349523125 g — so recipe and parcel math comes out right.
keyFacts: The kilogram is the SI base unit of mass, now defined by the Planck constant.
One pound equals exactly 453.59237 grams by international agreement.
One ounce equals exactly 28.349523125 grams; 16 ounces make a pound.
One stone equals 14 pounds (6.35029318 kg), still used for body weight in the UK.
A metric tonne is 1,000 kg; the US ton is 907.185 kg — they differ.
howTo: Type the weight value into the value field.
Choose the source unit from the "From" dropdown.
Choose the target unit from the "To" dropdown.
Read the converted weight instantly; swap reverses it.
Check the rate line for the exact factor used.
weight-converter.formula:
result = value × (from-unit in grams) ÷ (to-unit in grams)
Example: lb = kg × 1000 ÷ 453.59237
benefits: Metric and imperial weight units in one tool.

limitations: Converts mass/weight units; it does not convert weight to volume (density needed).
US tons and long tons are not included in this version.

faqs.q: How do I convert kg to pounds?
How many grams in an ounce?
faqs.a: Exactly 28.349523125 grams per avoirdupois ounce, the standard ounce for food and parcels.

faqs.q: What is a stone in kg?
faqs.a: One stone = 14 pounds = 6.35029318 kg. It is still commonly used for body weight in the UK and Ireland.

faqs.q: Is a tonne the same as a ton?
faqs.a: No. A metric tonne is 1,000 kg. A US (short) ton is 907.185 kg and a UK (long) ton is 1,016.05 kg.

faqs.q: Why does my recipe say 8 oz is 227 g?
faqs.a: Because 8 × 28.349523125 = 226.796 g, which recipes round to 227 g. This tool shows the unrounded value.
